1) the energy system can be modeled at a high-resolution, 2) high-resolution modeling can capture the dynamics of complex component/system interactions, 3) high-resolution modeling is useful for policy modeling, 4) the energy sector is undergoing rapid change, 5) the transformation of the energy sector is driven by the need to reduce emissions and improve energy efficiency and security, 6) the energy sector can be modeled at the level of individual entities, 7) multi-agent modeling
the use of distributed technologies in the energy sector is growing and that high-resolution models can be used to study the effects of such technologies.

(i) high-resolution models of distributed energy technologies can be used to support energy policy modeling; and (ii) multi-agent simulation can be combined with high-resolution modeling to yield a powerful entity-oriented modeling approach.

the development of new modeling techniques to support the analysis of distributed energy systems.
developing and deploying modeling tools and methods to support public policy decision-making for the energy sector.
the development of modeling and simulation methods for distributed energy technologies.
